Organization 
Navy Federal Credit Union is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial institution formed in 1933 under the

in its field of membership, which includes Active Duty, Veterans and retired military and civilian personnel 
who are, or were, employed by the Department of Defense, Coast Guard and their families. Navy Federal is
